title: Tips to Make a Difference in Your Wallet this Holiday Season | Civista
summary: Ten simple, practical tips to plan, protect, and stretch your holiday budget this season, plus Civista tools that help you stay on track.
body_markdown:
## Spend Smarter, Stress Less, and Start the New Year Strong


Gifts, travel, hosting, and those quick "just one more thing" trips add up fast this time of year. But a few small moves can make a real difference in how your wallet looks come January.


Here are 10 practical tips, plus a few Civista tools you may already have, to help you plan ahead, shop smarter, and enjoy the season without the money stress.


## Key Takeaways:


- **Plan first.** A written budget and gift list are the simplest ways to avoid overspending.
- **Shop with purpose.** Comparing prices and skipping impulse buys stretches every dollar.
- **Pay securely.** Digital wallets and fraud alerts help protect your money during the busiest shopping season.
- **Keep an eye on spending.** Digital banking, alerts, and the mobile app keep your spending visible.
- **Think ahead.** A Holiday Savings Club account makes next season easier on your budget.


## 1. Set One Holiday Budget


Before you buy a single gift, decide on one total number for the season. Include more than presents: food, decorations, travel, hosting, and those small extras are usually where budgets slip. A clear limit makes it easier to say no to the flashy sale you didn't plan for.


## 2. Make Your List and Give Everyone a Number


Write down everyone you're shopping for and assign each person a dollar amount. Seeing it on paper (or in your phone's notes) makes it easy to track progress and keeps one person's gift from eating up the whole budget.


## 3. Choose Gifts Before You Browse


Decide what you'll buy ahead of time. It keeps you focused on the person, not the doorbuster. And the simplest gifts are often the ones people remember.


## 4. Shop Around (and Shop Local)


A few minutes of comparison can save real money.


- **Compare prices.** Check online retailers and in-person stores before you buy.
- **Ask about price matching.** Some retailers will match a lower price you find elsewhere.
- **Support your neighbors.** Local small businesses often carry one-of-a-kind gifts, and every dollar spent close to home helps our communities thrive.


## 5. Pay with Your Digital Wallet


Add your Civista Debit Mastercard® to Apple Pay® or Google Pay™ for faster, more secure checkout. Each payment uses a one-time code in place of your card number, so your actual card number isn't shared with the merchant. It works for contactless payments in-store and at many online checkouts, too.


Learn how to get set up on our[Digital Wallet](https://www.civista.bank/personal-debit-cards/digital-wallet) page.


## 6. See All Your Spending in One Place


Holiday shopping often happens across several cards. Financial Tools in Civista Digital Banking lets you view your Civista accounts plus eligible accounts and credit cards from other institutions with one login.* It's an easy way to check your progress against your budget and spot anything that looks off.


## 7. Set Custom Account Alerts


In Digital Banking, go to Settings > Alerts to get notified when transactions post or when your balance drops below an amount you choose. No surprises at the checkout, and no guessing where you stand.


## 8. Keep Your Accounts in Your Pocket


The CB-Mobile Banking app lets you check balances, track spending, and transfer funds on the go from your phone, tablet, or Apple Watch. Perfect for a quick budget check before you head to the register.


## 9. Take Control of Your Debit Card


Debit Card Controls, found under Manage Cards in Digital Banking, help you stay in charge all season long.


- **Misplaced your card?** Turn it off instantly, then back on when you find it. If it's truly lost, report it from the same menu. Many branches can issue a new card on the spot.
- **Planning a big purchase?** Request a temporary point-of-sale limit increase before you shop. Requests can take up to four business hours to review and depend on your account balances and activity.
- **Traveling for the holidays?** Share your travel plans so your card keeps working without interruption.
- **Watch for fraud alerts.** I f we spot unusual activity on your card, we’ll reach out by text, email, and phone. Make sure your contact information is up to date so the alert reaches you.


## 10. Start Saving for Next Year Now


The easiest holiday season is the one you've already saved for. You can open a Civista Holiday Savings Club account with just $10, and set up automatic transfers from your checking or savings so your balance grows in the background. Your funds are ready in mid-October, right when holiday planning kicks off.


## Small Steps, Big Difference


You don't need a complete money makeover to have a better holiday season. Pick a few of these tips, put them to work, and let the tools already built into your Civista accounts do some of the heavy lifting. Your wallet, and your January self, will thank you.
